summary: Comprehensive testing of Vehicle HMI for 1989 Honda Accord completed. Backend APIs all passing (25/25 tests). Frontend dashboard loads correctly with gauges, settings, and Android Auto panel working. Polling interval fix verified (200ms). Minor cosmetic bug: 'OFFLINE' status shown despite data being received.

ui_bugs.issue: Connection status shows 'OFFLINE' despite data being received via HTTP polling. Race condition: ws.onclose sets isConnected=false after polling starts.

passed_tests: GET /api/vehicle-data returns valid vehicle signals (200 OK)
Vehicle data has all required fields (rpm, speed_mph, gear, etc.)
Speed values in valid range (0-170 mph)
Gear values in valid range (-1 to 6)
API handles 5 requests/second (200ms interval) without issues
Frontend polling uses 200ms interval (verified via console log)
WebSocket fallback to HTTP polling works correctly
Dashboard loads after boot sequence (~8-12 seconds)
Shift lights activate at high RPM
Theme selection works (Type R, Retro '89, Clean OEM)
Android Auto button opens mock panel
Android Auto panel shows navigation UI (MOCKED)

Console log confirms: 'Starting HTTP polling at 200ms interval'
